segments.ja362:1.1: Sīlaṃ seyyo sutaṃ seyyo, iti me saṃsayo ahu;
segments.ja362:1.3: Sīlameva sutā seyyo, iti me natthi saṃsayo.
segments.ja362:2.1: Moghā jāti ca vaṇṇo ca, sīlameva kiruttamaṃ;
segments.ja362:4.3: Idha dhammaṃ caritvāna, bhavanti tidive samā.
segments.ja362:5.1: Na vedā samparāyāya, na jāti nāpi [nopi (pī.)] bandhavā;
segments.ja362:5.3: Sakañca sīlaṃ saṃsuddhaṃ, samparāyāya sukhāya cāti [sukhāvahanti (sī. syā.)].

lines: Yā hi yasmā sīlarahitassa jātisampadā vā vaṇṇasampadā vā saggasukhaṃ dātuṃ na sakkoti, tasmā ubhayampi taṃ “moghan”ti āha.
Sīlameva kirāti anussavavasena vadati, na pana sayaṃ jānāti.
Sutenattho na vijjatīti sīlarahitassa sutapariyattimattena idhaloke vā paraloke vā kāci vaḍḍhi nāma natthi.
